coreAttributes.name: ankle boot
coreAttributes.description: A pair of feminine ankle boots, with the heel being raised off the ground in order to make the wearer taller, as well as to accentuate their calf muscles and the overall length of their legs.

replacementText.self: [npc.Name] slip [npc.her] [npc.feet] into the ankle boots and zip up the sides.
replacementText.other: [npc.Name] slip [npc2.namePos] [npc2.feet] into the ankle boots and zip up the sides.
replacementText.otherRough: [npc.Name] roughly push [npc2.namePos] [npc2.feet] into the ankle boots and zip up the sides.

displacementText.self: [npc.Name] unzip [npc.her] ankle boots and slip them off.
displacementText.other: [npc.Name] unzip [npc2.namePos] ankle boots and slip them off.
displacementText.otherRough: [npc.Name] roughly unzip [npc2.namePos] ankle boots and yank them off.
